svg.title: MCP client, server and tool
svg.desc: A dashed blue frame, tag 1, holds an orange LLM block, a blue Orchestrator block and, below them, a blue MCP client block, tag 2. Arrows labeled tools/list and tools/call go right from the client to an MCP server frame, tag 3, and an arrow labeled results comes back. The server holds three blocks: Tool: move-agv, Resources and Prompts. An arrow goes from the tool to a green block, tag 4, labeled /agvN/move.
